title: AI-driven defensive cybersecurity strategy analysis and recommendation system
abstract: A system and method for AI-driven defensive cybersecurity strategy analysis and recommendation, in which machine learning models analyze cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and defensive capabilities to generate optimized cybersecurity strategies and recommendations for protecting computer networks and information systems.
relevance_reason: Explicitly directed to defensive cybersecurity strategy using AI, and listed as having Active status in the search results.

title: Implementing hierarchical cybersecurity systems and methods
abstract: Systems and methods for implementing hierarchical cybersecurity architectures, where multiple layers of cybersecurity controls and policies are coordinated to protect computing resources, networks, and data assets, enabling dynamic and scalable defense against cyber threats.
relevance_reason: Described as an Active patent focusing on hierarchical cybersecurity systems and methods, directly related to cybersecurity protection.

title: Real-time network intrusion detection system
abstract: A real-time network intrusion detection system and method for detecting cyberattacks on monitored networks, analyzing network traffic and events to identify malicious activity and generate alerts or automated responses.
relevance_reason: The patent is explicitly focused on real-time detection of cyberattacks on networks, a core cybersecurity function, and appears to be a recent, active grant.

title: Real-time network intrusion detection method based on deep learning
abstract: A real-time network intrusion detection method based on deep learning, belonging to the field of network security technology, where deep neural networks are trained to recognize and classify intrusion behaviors in network traffic to improve the accuracy and timeliness of cybersecurity monitoring.
relevance_reason: The abstract explicitly states it relates to network security and real-time intrusion detection using deep learning, a key cybersecurity application.

title: Intrusion investigation
abstract: An intrusion investigation system and method for analyzing security events in computer networks, enabling automated collection, correlation, and assessment of data related to suspected intrusions to support cybersecurity incident response and forensics.
relevance_reason: Concerned with investigation and analysis of network intrusions, closely tied to cybersecurity incident response, and appears as a granted, currently active European patent.
